MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 32
   C. 12
   D. 33

2. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 13
   C. 17
   D. 7

3. Solve for x: x + 4 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 12
   C. 16
   D. 4

4. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 12.5
   C. 6
   D. 25

5. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x + 2

6. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.7
   C. 37
   D. 31.6

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 34
   B. 17
   C. 22
   D. 66

8. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 90
   C. 81
   D. 18

9. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 2/2
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/4
   D. Cannot tell

10. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 25

11. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 26
   C. 13
   D. 169

12. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 24
   C. 42
   D. 36

13. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 10

14. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 48
   C. 49
   D. 2

15. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 42
   C. 21
   D. 90

16. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.6
   C. 19
   D. 19.7

17. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 72
   B. 17
   C. 1
   D. 73

18. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 29
   C. 3
   D. 28

19. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 15
   C. 15.6
   D. 21

20. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

21. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 49
   C. 7
   D. 50

22. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 9

23. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.6
   C. 29
   D. 23.7

24. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
